text: The blood work is normal, which rules out infection or liver failure. Given your history of risperidone use and the new movement disorder, are you experiencing muscle stiffness, tremors, or a feeling of inner restlessness?

speaker: Doctor
text: The symptoms you describe—pacing, fidgeting, and an inability to remain still—are classic signs of akathisia. Given that this started two months after beginning risperidone, it is highly likely this is a side effect of the medication. Have you noticed any worsening of these feelings at night or after taking your dose?
